title: Noncommutative protori and inductive spectral triples
summary: We study inductive limits of higher-dimensional noncommutative tori, which we call noncommutative protori. We compute the Elliott invariants for broad classes of unital and nonunital systems, including toric maps, Morita-corner embeddings, and dimension-changing and proper embeddings. For the resulting simple limits we determine explicitly the ordered $K$-groups, trace cone, scale, and projection scale, yielding concrete classification criteria.
